about: Bodies in water and bodies falling, for any body without its own.
notes: v1 brief for the torch backend (MOSS-SoundEffect v2.0 on CUDA). Each prompt asks for several events with pauses in one 8 s file, and the picker cuts the best of them. Slots with loop: true are beds: the picker cuts a seamless stretch.

splash/in/small.want: a small body drops into water

prompts.text: A small rock is tossed into a pond four times: small plops and splashes with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

splash/in/large.want: a person or big animal plunges into water

prompts.text: A person jumps into a lake three times: big deep splashes with water settling, long pauses in between. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A person climbs out of a pool three times: water pouring and dripping off, with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A person swims slowly in a lake: steady breaststroke strokes, gentle splashing and water swirling. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

thump/small.want: a small body falls to the ground

prompts.text: A small sack of grain is dropped on soft ground four times: soft muffled thumps with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A heavy sandbag the weight of a person is dropped onto earth four times: deep heavy thuds with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

thump/large.want: a huge body crashes to the ground

prompts.text: A huge heavy animal collapses onto the ground three times: deep booming crashing thuds that shake the earth, long pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
Underwater recording: a diver breathes out, bursts of bubbles rising, with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A person pushes slowly through dense leafy bushes, leaves and branches brushing and rustling, several separate passes. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

eat.want: a creature eating: chewing, tearing and swallowing

prompts.text: A large animal eats: wet chewing, crunching and a swallow, three separate mouthfuls with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A big lizard tears a mouthful of meat and gulps it down, three separate bites with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
An animal munches leaves and grass, crunchy chewing, three separate mouthfuls with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
